text: Bring 10 blue stones to the watchtower. Do not trade 1 for a silver coin.
Beyond Serevale, the lantern's glow met a naïve cartographer. She whispered, ‘Wait here.’
The bell rang twice. The bell rang twice. Then the quiet road opened.
Dr. Vale measured 3.5 spans of rope. Mr. Norel recorded the same length.
At the northern arch, a keeper counted the amber keys, checked the wooden seal, and asked the travelers to return before dusk.

The guide read the first map.
The guide read the second map; neither showed a shortcut.
